scripts.native:build:discovery: dotnet publish desktop-native/Oracle.WindowDiscovery/Oracle.WindowDiscovery.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false --output dist-native
scripts.native:build:observer: dotnet publish desktop-native/Oracle.WindowObserver/Oracle.WindowObserver.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false --output dist-native
scripts.native:build: npm run native:build:discovery && npm run native:build:observer
scripts.desktop:build: npm run native:build && npm run desktop:compile
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build && concurrently -k "next dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/oracle && electron ."
